text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Why won't Taiki fall into the 
pitfall trap I went through all the 
trouble of digging~?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What? A pitfall trap...? Windy-san, did 
you really dig something like that?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I dug it up~. But Taiki just went whoooosh 
and leaped right over it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I chased after them yelling "Wait!", and 
Windy-chan ended up falling down by 
mistake...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woow, I'm so sorry about that...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's right, *yes*! Then next time, 
Windy-san, call out to me from the bottom 
of the hall, *please*!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I will gladly dive right 
in myself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Then that's what we shall do! This 
time for sure, we'll say, "Serves you 
right!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Next time as well, please put 
Windy-san first!
